description: Allows the Strategy Admin to create a new KPI definition, such as its group, code, name, unit, formula, aggregation type and direction, to be used for performance evaluation.
preconditions: The user is logged in as a Strategy Admin.
User navigates to the "Định nghĩa KPI" section in the sidebar.
postconditions: KPI definition is saved in the database with status Draft.
The new KPI is reflected in the KPI catalog.
basicFlow: User clicks the "+ Tạo KPI mới" (Create) button.
System displays the "Tạo mới định nghĩa KPI" modal.
User enters KPI data and clicks the "Tạo KPI" button.
System validates that mandatory fields are not empty.
System checks if the KPI Code conflicts with other existing KPIs.
System closes the modal and refreshes the list.

alternativeFlows.title: Step 4.1_Empty Required Field Error
steps: User leaves the KPI Code, Name, Group or Unit empty.
System displays error message: "Vui lòng nhập mã KPI." / "Tên KPI không được để trống." / "Vui lòng chọn nhóm KPI." / "Đơn vị không được để trống." (MSGxx).

alternativeFlows.title: Step 5.1_Duplicate Code Error
steps: User enters a KPI Code that already exists for another KPI.
System displays error message: "Mã KPI '{code}' đã tồn tại trong hệ thống." (MSGxx).
